verdict.summary: Notes 7.7 (n=14, min 6.5); Settings 8.2 (n=4). The owner's double-left objection is resolved in every captured state: each desktop capture has exactly one full-height divider at x239/240 (stage-04 control: x240 and x500), and phones use one column. Not satisfied for 8: the first-run empty state (empty means 6.7) hides every forward action. 'Select a notebook' has no notebooks or New notebook visible, the new-page + is disabled, and 'Create a note' is gated on a selected notebook. Populated Notes views average 8.0.
